correctness.rationale: Direct Zorn expansion gives [A,B]=[omega(w,t),alpha t+beta w; omega(w,t)]. For each nonzero six-vector, nondegeneracy of the alternating pairing yields q^5 solutions, and the disjoint alpha/beta cases give (q²−1)q^7. Zero and scalar counts follow by explicit q^6/q^5 counts; the q^16 total-mass identity is checked algebraically. The embedded checker exhausts all 65,536 binary ordered pairs and validates the formula on all 128 trace-zero outputs.
